Package frc.robot

Class Constants.MotorConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.Constants.MotorConstants
Enclosing class:
Constants
public static class Constants.MotorConstants extends Object
Legacy CAN IDs for motors not yet migrated to subsystem-specific constants classes. These IDs are from the Hackbots configuration and require re-assignment in Stage 8-1.
